name: orch
description: Code-first orchestrator for chaining coding-agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex)

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:two-pane:lifecycle
scripts.check:release: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:project && bun run test:two-pane:lifecycle && bun run test:two-pane:full:real
scripts.test:two-pane:fast: bun test tests-new/model tests-new/tmux-argv tests-new/dsl/__tests__ tests-new/dsl/panes/__tests__ tests-new/dsl/drivers/__tests__/model-driver.test.ts tests-new/dsl/drivers/__tests__/full-host-static-app.test.ts tests-new/_migration/__tests__ && bun run overlap-report
scripts.test:two-pane: bun run test:two-pane:fast && bun run test:two-pane:tmux
scripts.test:two-pane:all: bun run test:two-pane && bun run test:two-pane:lifecycle && bun run test:two-pane:full:real
scripts.test:legacy: bun test tests/unit tests/integration && bun run test:legacy:e2e
scripts.test:project: bun run test:legacy && bun run test:new-unit && bun run test:new-int && bun run test:new-e2e && bun run test:two-pane
